metadata.description: VoltEdge Tech Store portable multi-agent network conforming to Neuro SAN HOCON & MVP Profile 0.2

tools.name: FrontDesk_Coordinator

function.description: Public Front Man entry point for VoltEdge Tech Store. Grounds user requests against live DOM state and delegates to internal specialists or approved peer networks.

inquiry.description: User request for the VoltEdge Tech Store.

tools.instructions: Always call getPageState first. Delegate non-destructive form updates (R < 0.65) to State_Form_Specialist, high-risk writes (R >= 0.65) to Critical_Action_Specialist, and cross-site inquiries to worldwide_agentic_web_peer.

tools.name: State_Form_Specialist

function.description: Executes safe, reversible DOM form updates and queries.

tools.instructions: Operate only on registered site actions whose Mutation Risk Score R(e_i) is below tau_HITL (0.65).

tools.name: Critical_Action_Specialist

function.description: Proposes irreversible or high-risk DOM mutations that require user-owned runtime confirmation.

tools.instructions: Propose validated action arguments and wait for the browser runtime to obtain explicit human approval and issue a signed action receipt.
